user.title: Replace Device
user.description: Replace a dead or old device with a new one. The new device takes over the names, entity IDs, area and history, so your automations and dashboards keep working. Afterwards, find **Replace a device** on this integration's page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Replace Device is already set up.

user.title: Replace a device
user.description: Pair the new device first, as you normally would. Then pick the old and the new one.

data_description.old_device: The one that is dead or being replaced.

match.title: Which is which?
match.description:
**{old}** → **{new}**

For each entity of the old device, the matching entity of the new one is picked. Change it if it's wrong, or pick — to remove it.

init.title: AI help (optional)
init.description: Pick an AI Task entity, e.g. Google Gemini. It is only asked when Replace Device can't match something by itself: entities with different names on the old and new device, and button triggers that are called something else in the new integration. Only names and types are sent, never states or your setup.

data_description.ai_task: Leave empty to not use AI. Tip: give it its own free Gemini key, so it doesn't share the daily quota with other things.
